review_candidates.title: Founding Engineer (Backend-Leaning)
review_candidates.description: Founding Engineer (Backend-Leaning) Location: San Francisco, California, USA Working model: Fully in-person, 9 AM–5 PM Salary: $160,000–$180,000 base + 0.5–1% equity Experience: 1+ years (typically 1–4 years; exceptional new graduates welcome) Visa sponsorship: Not available at this time; candidates must be US-based and authorised to work without sponsorship Open positions: 3 About the company Join a seed-stage AI startup building an AI workforce for direct procurement at large manufacturing companies. Direct procurement is a critical but often overlooked part of manufacturing, involving the sourcing and purchasing of the materials and components businesses need to operate. The company is building AI-powered solutions to automate complex workflows, improve efficiency and solve problems that traditional software has struggled to address. The business is already closing enterprise contracts worth up to approximately $1 million, creating an opportunity to join at an early stage while the product and customer base are growing. You'll join a small, driven team where engineers have substantial ownership, work directly with customers and have the opportunity to grow into leadership as the company scales. The role As a Founding Engineer, you'll help build and deploy AI-powered software that transforms how large manufacturers manage procurement. This is a backend-leaning full-stack role for someone who enjoys solving difficult technical problems, building practical AI systems and taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tickets. You'll work across backend systems, LLM agents, tool use, evaluations and user-facing product features. Just as importantly, you'll be involved throughout the customer journey, from initial conversations and understanding business problems to implementation and deployment. With three positions available, this is an opportunity to join early, shape the engineering culture and potentially grow into a team leadership role as the company expands. What you'll do Build and deploy AI-powered systems that automate direct procurement workflows. Develop backend services and full-stack features using technologies such as Python, TypeScript, Java or C++. Implement LLM agents, tool integrations, evaluation frameworks and guardrails. Design reliable systems that can handle complex enterprise workflows and real-world customer requirements. Work directly with customers to understand their processes and translate business problems into technical solutions. Own enterprise accounts and implementations from initial discovery through deployment. Evaluate AI system performance, identify failure modes and improve reliability. Take ownership of technical challenges, make independent decisions and contribute to product direction. Help establish engineering standards and practices as the team grows. Develop towards greater responsibility, including the potential to lead engineers and technical projects. What we're looking for At least 1 year of relevant engineering experience, although exceptional new graduates are encouraged to apply. Strong backend engineering skills and the ability to work across the full stack. Experience with one or more of Python, TypeScript, Java or C++. Practical experience with LLMs, AI agents, tool use or evaluation systems. Strong computer science fundamentals and the ability to solve unfamiliar problems independently. A track record of building things beyond narrowly defined assignments. The ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical solutions for customers. A proactive, ownership-driven approach suited to a small, fast-moving startup. Willingness to work in person in San Francisco. Existing US work authorisation that does not require employer sponsorship. We're looking for demonstrated technical ability, not credentials alone. Competitive programming, quantitative work, entrepreneurial experience or an impressive product you've built independently can all provide evidence of exceptional problem-solving skills. What will make you stand out? Competitive programming: Experience or strong results in competitions such as ICPC, USACO, IOI, programming olympiads or Codeforces. Quantitative background: Experience in quantitative finance or another environment that demands rigorous analytical thinking. Founder experience: You've started a company, taken a product to market or learned valuable lessons from a venture that didn't succeed. Independent building: You've created a product or tool without being asked, ideally with real users. Practical AI engineering: You've built LLM agents and can explain how you evaluate their performance, manage failure modes and implement guardrails. Backend depth: You can design and build reliable systems rather than focusing exclusively on frontend development. Customer ownership: You're comfortable speaking directly with customers and taking responsibility for successful implementations. Why join? Founding-team ownership: Help shape the product, technical architecture and engineering culture from an early stage. Real enterprise impact: Build AI products for large manufacturers with significant operational challenges and commercial value. End-to-end responsibility: Work directly with customers and own projects through to deployment. Career growth: Develop the skills and experience to grow into a technical lead or engineering leadership position. Meaningful equity: Receive 0.5–1% equity alongside a $160,000–$180,000 base salary. A small, driven team: Work in an environment where individual contributions have a direct effect on the company's success. Interview process Co-founder introduction: Discuss your background, motivation and interest in the business. Take-home assignment: Complete a short, screen-recorded technical assignment. AI tools are allowed, and you'll provide a short video explaining your work. Technical conversation: Discuss your solution, engineering decisions, problem-solving approach and technical fundamentals. Paid work trial: Work with the team for two to five days on practical projects. Offer: Successful candidates receive an offer to join the founding team. Interested? If you're a backend-leaning engineer who enjoys building practical AI systems, solving difficult problems and taking ownership in an early-stage company, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and links to relevant projects, GitHub repositories, competition results or products you've built. As part of the process, be prepared to explain why you want to join a small company operating in an unglamorous but commercially important industry like direct procurement. An honest answer is encouraged.

review_candidates.description: Vill du utveckla teknik där prestanda och realtidskommunikation är avgörande? Vi söker nu tre erfarna ingenjörer inom industriell kommunikation och embedded systems till ett seniort ingenjörsteam hos en ledande aktör inom sitt teknikområde. Här står prestanda, precision och tillförlitlig realtidskommunikation i centrum, och produkterna utvecklas med ambitionen att ligga i absolut framkant. Om rollen I rollen arbetar du med utveckling av mjukvara och kommunikationslösningar för industriella system med höga krav på prestanda och realtidsegenskaper. Du blir en del av ett kompetent team med cirka 50 ingenjörer, där du får möjlighet att bidra till avancerad teknikutveckling och arbeta med lösningar där industriella kommunikationsprotokoll spelar en central roll. Vi söker dig som har: Har en Civil- eller högskoleingenjörsexamen inom exempelvis datateknik, elektroteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande Har 5-8 års yrkesrelevant erfarenhet inom det tekniska område vi söker till Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Erfarenhet inom flertalet av nedanstående är ett krav: PROFINET EtherCAT EtherNet/IP (Industrial Protocol) – industriell kommunikation CC-Link Modbus CANopen Det viktigaste är att du har praktisk erfarenhet flera av dessa protokoll och en god förståelse för industriell kommunikation. Djup kompetens inom flera av protokollen är särskilt intressant. Det är ett plus om du även har erfarenhet av: Realtidsoperativsystem (RTOS) Lågnivåprogrammering i C Ethernet och nätverkskommunikation på generell nivå Kravbaserad utveckling enligt V-modellen Placering och upplägg Vi ser gärna att du finns i Göteborgsområdet för närhet till vårt Syntronic-kontor samt kan arbeta på plats hos kunden i Halmstad någon till ett par dagar i veckan. Om dig Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av industriella kommunikationsprotokoll och som förstår hur dessa används i avancerade tekniska produkter. Du trivs i en miljö där teknisk kompetens, kvalitet och effektivitet är avgörande. Du är nyfiken på varför saker fungerar, och tar gärna reda på varför de ibland inte gör det. Du arbetar strukturerat, tar initiativ och följer problem hela vägen till en fungerande lösning. Vi erbjuder Syntronic erbjuder en trygg anställning i en dynamisk och framåtriktad miljö. Att vi är ett team är vår styrka, därför ser vi att du arbetar tillsammans på plats med oss på kontoret – när du inte behövs hos någon av våra kunder förstås! På Syntronic blir du en del av en härlig gemenskap där din röst hörs och dina idéer välkomnas. Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider, balans mellan arbete och fritid samt regelbundna karriärutvecklingssamtal och interna workshops för din utveckling. Utöver detta får du förmånliga förmåner och försäkringar. Ansökan Vi ser fram emot din ansökan, som ska vara oss tillhanda senast 16/11. Vi gör urval löpande och matchar din profil mot aktuella och kommande uppdrag hos våra kunder. Våra processer kan därför variera i tid beroende på när rätt möjlighet dyker upp. Just nu ser vi ett ökat behov av den här kompetensen på marknaden – och det kan innebära spännande nya möjligheter för dig framöver. Bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma. Av kommunikation- och kvalitetssäkringsskäl ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan digitalt via vårt system och inte via e-post. Vi kan använda AI och automatiserade verktyg som stöd i vår rekryteringsprocess. Alla beslut om urval och anställning fattas alltid av människor.

review_candidates.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
review_candidates.description: At First.Tech , we're building and scaling technology products across financial services and other high-impact industries. Our engineering teams work on real products, real customers, and applications that need to deliver reliable, secure, and seamless user experiences at scale. We're looking for a Lead Frontend Engineer who combines strong hands-on frontend engineering expertise with technical leadership. You'll lead the development of scalable, high-quality frontend applications, drive engineering best practices, and help shape technical decisions while remaining actively involved in coding and delivery. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys solving complex frontend challenges, improving application architecture and performance, and helping other engineers grow. What you'll be working on Lead the design, development, and evolution of modern frontend applications using React, TypeScript, and contemporary JavaScript technologies. Define and promote scalable frontend architecture, reusable components, state management patterns, and maintainable code structures. Translate product requirements and design concepts into responsive, accessible, and high-quality user interfaces. Drive technical decisions around frontend architecture, application performance, scalability, security, and maintainability. Establish coding standards, lead code reviews, and promote engineering best practices across the frontend team. Optimize application performance, loading times, rendering efficiency, and overall user experience. Collaborate closely with Product, UX/UI Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver end-to-end product features. Ensure frontend applications integrate reliably with REST APIs and backend services. Promote automated testing, debugging, quality assurance, and continuous improvement of frontend development practices. Mentor frontend engineers, provide technical guidance, and encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning. Take ownership of frontend solutions throughout their lifecycle, from technical design and development to deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement. Evaluate and encourage the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, and engineering efficiency. We're looking for someone who Has 8+ years of professional software engineering experience , with substantial experience in frontend development. Has strong hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Has experience designing and developing scalable, maintainable, and component-based frontend applications. Has a solid understanding of frontend architecture, reusable design patterns, state management, and modern application development practices. Has experience managing application state using tools such as Redux or comparable state management solutions. Understands REST APIs, asynchronous programming, browser behavior, and frontend/backend integration. Has experience optimizing frontend performance, improving rendering efficiency, and troubleshooting complex UI issues. Has experience with code reviews, technical decision-making, and establishing frontend engineering standards. Has mentored developers or provided technical guidance to frontend engineering teams. Understands automated testing, Git, CI/CD, and modern Agile software development practices. Has exposure to responsive design, accessibility standards, cross-browser compatibility, and frontend security best practices. Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Is comfortable balancing hands-on development with technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration. Frontend engineering at First.Tech is evolving We're actively adopting AI-assisted engineering across our development lifecycle. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about new tools and understand how to use them responsibly, whether that's Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or other AI-assisted development tools. As a technical leader, you'll help establish the right practices for reviewing, testing, validating, and improving AI-assisted code rather than simply accepting generated output. Why join First.Tech? You'll have the opportunity to: Lead the technical direction of frontend applications supporting digital products in the financial technology space. Solve complex challenges involving application architecture, performance, scalability, and user experience. Influence frontend engineering standards, reusable components, and development practices. Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, QA, DevOps, and technology leadership. Mentor engineers and help strengthen the team's technical capabilities. Explore modern frontend development approaches, including AI-assisted engineering. Make a meaningful impact on products, technology decisions, and engineering delivery. The details 📍 Location: Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt 🏢 Working model: On-site, 5 days per week 💻 Core technology stack: React | TypeScript | JavaScript | HTML5 | CSS3 | Redux | REST APIs | Frontend Testing | CI/CD | AI-assisted development
